Element.Name: Claimant

Fill in - if possible - information about coverage by social security scheme, family relationship and status of the person.

Element.Name: InformationSpouseOrPartner

Element.Explanatory: Personal information concerning the spouse or partner; name(s), address and other elements. The mandatory fields to be filled in are fields of identification items: family name(s), forename(s), birth date, sex and town of birth. Fill in - if possible - information about coverage by social security scheme, family relationship and status of the person.

Element.Name: InformationOtherPersons
Element.Label: Information on other persons
Element.Explanatory: Personal information concerning the other person e.g. grandparents, add name(s), address, and other elements of that person. Other person could also be parent(s) of the child, if the child is claimant. If the child is claimant, add in this field information of parent(s) or person(s) whose activity entitles to family benefit. The mandatory fields to be filled in are fields of identification items: family name(s), forename(s), date of birth, sex and town of birth. Fill in - if possible - information about coverage by social security scheme, family relationship and status of the person.

Element.Name: ClaimingAuthority

Element.Explanatory: Personal information concerning the child(ren); name(s), address and other elements. Child s address is necessary only if it is different of claimant, spouse, partner or other person. The mandatory fields to be filled in are fields of identification items: family name(s), forename(s), date of birth, sex and town of birth.

If you prefer this information per child(ren) or total amount for entire family, mention it and other details in additional information, if necessary.

Element.Name: ClaimForReimbursementWithArticle58RegulationNo987
Element.Label: Claim for reimbursement with article 58 of Regulation (EC) No 987/2009
Element.Explanatory: Only to be filled if purpose of this SED is "Reimbursement according to article 58 of Regulation (EC) No 987/2009". Mention all relevant details concerning your claim as in request of overpayment reimbursement per child or for the entire family.

Element.Name: PurposeThisSED
Element.Label: Purpose of this SED
Element.Explanatory: Choose the appropriate box for the reason of this document, e.g. box "reply to check or annual check" for ongoing cases, if there has been no change in circumstances in replying institution. If there has been change in circumstances for ongoing cases, choose the box "Information about change in circumstances". It is possible to choose more than one box. Reimbursement according to article 58 of Regulation (EC) No 987/2009 means that more than two countries are involved. For all other reimbursement claim(s) use R-SED(s).

Element.Name: InformationAboutChangeInCircumstances
Element.Label: Information about change in circumstances
Element.Explanatory: Only to be filled if purpose of this SED is "Information about change in circumstances". Choose the appropriate box. It is possible to choose more than one box if information is not about entire family.

Element.Name: AdditionalRequestOrInformation

Verify the type and period(s) of decision by filling the relevant box.

Element.Name: Persons
Element.Label: Persons
Element.Explanatory: SEDs can include details of more than one person (e.g. insured person and widow in case of survivor benefits or the heir of a deceased benefit recipient who is liable to refund the overpayment). It is important to define clearly who is who. It allows the receiving institution to identify, assign and proceed the sent data correctly. To help categorise the persons, the ‘Persons’ section consists in two sections ‘Debtor’ and ‘Other Persons’. The mandatory section ‘Debtor’ has a choice field where the Debtor category is selected between ‘Insured Person’, ‘Beneficiary’ and ‘Third Party’. Based on the selection of the ‘Debtor’ category, one, two or three corresponding non-repetitive subsections become visible. In each section, an adapted list of statuses is available (when relevant for ‘Beneficiary’ and ‘Third Party’). The non-mandatory repetitive section labelled ‘Other Persons’ is provided following the ‘Debtor’ section to contain other persons of interest in the case.

Element.Name: RecoveryClaim
Element.Label: Recovery of the claim
Element.Explanatory: Advise the applicant institution whether the claim has been recovered in full or in part. If in part, advise the applicant institution whether procedures to recover the remaining amount will continue. In cases where the recovered amount is reduced before the transfer because of costs related to recovery action according to Decision No R1 of 20.06.2013 Point 4 and no further recovery action is going to be taken, please provide the necessary additional information here.

Property.Property: Specify if a connector is read-only (ENUM type)=

Element.Name: Contestation
Element.Label: Contestation
Element.Explanatory: This concerns disputes. The debtor (person or employer) may dispute: the claim and/or the instrument permitting enforcement issued by the applicant institution. The debtor (person or employer) may also dispute: a replacement/additional instrument permitting enforcement issued by the requested institution and/or the enforcement action taken by the requested institution. The contestation may be raised with the applicant or the requested institution. The institution notified of the contestation is required to inform the other institution of the dispute, of action it has taken or to request instruction on further action required.

Element.Name: ImpactContestation
Element.Label: Impact of contestation
Element.Explanatory: The purpose of this section is to either a) request the action required if you are the applicant institution OR b) state the action taken or to request further instruction if you are the requested institution.

Element.Name: Request
Element.Label: Request
Element.Explanatory: Tick or select the appropriate box. If estimated costs/losses concern further recovery action, no further recovery action will be taken until agreement to pay the estimated costs/losses has been reached. For this reason a deadline date for reply is to be provided.

Element.Name: Reply
Element.Label: Reply
Element.Explanatory: State if you accept the liability to reimburse the actual and/or estimated costs and/or losses covered in the R028 request. If you do not, provide reasons. Where reimbursement is in accordance with Decision No R1 of 20.06.2013 Point 5 the costs have to be reimbursed by the applicant institution if no different procedure has been agreed.

Element.Name: ResponseFromRequestedInstitution
Element.Label: Response from requested institution
Element.Explanatory: The "applicant institution" (which sent the R017 request) has sent the "requested institution" an R019 advising that the debtor is disputing the claim/Instrument Permitting Enforcement issued (by the applicant institution). The R019 from the "applicant institution" may have requested further action to be taken by the "requested institution". This section is completed by the "requested institution" to advise the "applicant institution" whether it can take the requested action. Tick or select the appropriate box(es).

Element.Name: ResponseFromApplicantInstitution
Element.Label: Response from applicant institution
Element.Explanatory: The "requested institution" (which received the R017 request) has sent the "applicant institution" an R019. The R019 advised that the debtor is either a) disputing the claim/Instrument Permitting Enforcement with the "applicant institution" OR b) disputing the enforcement action taken by the "requested institution". The R019 from the "requested institution" may have asked for further instruction from the "applicant institution". This section is completed by the "applicant institution" to provide instruction on the further action required from the "requested institution". Tick or select the appropriate box.

Element.Name: ResultContestation
Element.Label: Result of contestation
Element.Explanatory: Tick or select the result of the contestation. Also give the date the decision was made.

Element.Name: ImpactDecision
Element.Label: Impact of decision
Element.Explanatory: Tick or select the action to take, or has been taken, as a result of the decision on the contestation. If the decision is that of a judicial or administrative tribunal, a copy of that decision must be attached to the SED.

Element.Name: kindIncomeBenefits
Element.Label: Kind of income / benefits
Element.Explanatory: Income from capital: State if the claimant receive income from capital (Profit shares (dividends), other income from shares or participation involving an interest in a joint-stock company; Income from participation in a commercial enterprise as a dormant partner, Interest and earnings from any kind of capital claim; Proceeds of disposal of shares after 31.12.2008 , Time bargains following a contract); Income from insurance: State if the claimant receive income from insurance (Payment of insurance benefits upon performance of a contract (excluding insurance policies, which became due as a result of the death); Redemption of an insurance); Income from letting or leasing: State if the claimant receive Income from letting or leasing; Capital gains from sales transactions for own account: State if the claimant receive Capital gains from sales transactions for own account (Alienation of land, real estate within 10 years of acquisition; Sales of other assets within 1 years of acquisition; Sickness benefits from a private insurance: State if the claimant receive a benefit from a private insurance which is paid for the duration of temporary sickness; Unemployment benefits from a private insurance: State if the claimant receive a benefit which is paid for the duration of unemployment compensation; Old-age pension or pensions on account of reduced earning capacity from employment (Stuff pension fund): State if the claimant receive a benefit from a Stuff pension fund), which because of Old-age or of not only temporary invalidity; Old-age pension or pensions on account of reduced earning capacity from private life or pension amount: State if the claimant receive a benefit from private life or pension amount, which because of Old-age or of not only temporary invalidity.

Element.Name: status
Element.Label: Status
Element.Explanatory: Status should always indicate the present state of the individual claim. Status "01 - Accepted" should be set for all the individual claims which are not included in the previous U023 - "Reimbursement Contestation" (and are not yet "notified as paid in U024"). Individual claims for which a U024 - "Reimbursement Payment Notification" was received should have the status "02 - Notified as paid in U024". If the creditor does not agree with non-acceptance or partial-acceptance of the individual claim in the previous U023 - "Reimbursement Contestation", it should set the status to "06 - Under dispute" and provide further reasoning.

Element.Explanatory: Technical field: Identification number of the request for reimbursement - same identification number as in global part of this SED. Purpose of this field is to keep traceability between the Master (= general information part of the SED) and Child (= individual claims part of the SED) SEDs throughout the reimbursement procedure.

Element.Label: Sequential number of Individual claim
Element.Explanatory: Number for each Individual claim - starting from N°1, N°2, etc. This number is an identifier for the individual claim within the whole reimbursement process (U023 - "Reimbursement Contestation", U024 - "Reimbursement Payment Notification", U026 - "Charging Interest", U027 - "Reply on Interest", U029 - "Amended reimbursement request reacting to contestation").

Element.Name: InstitutionWhichCertifiedInsuranceRecord
Element.Label: Institution which certified insurance record
Element.Explanatory: Details of the institution in the Member State of last activity which certified the periods of insurance/employment which were considered by the Member State of residence for the entitlement to unemployment benefit for which the reimbursement is claimed.

Element.Name: WorkingPeriodsConsidered
Element.Label: Working periods considered
Element.Explanatory: Periods of employment and self-employment completed in the Member State of last activity during the preceding 24 months. Depending on the length of these periods a 3 or 5 month reimbursement claim is justified under Article 65(7) of Regulation (EC) No 883/2004.

Element.Name: ReimbursementPeriod
Element.Label: Reimbursement period
Element.Explanatory: Period for which the reimbursement is requested. Start date is the first day for which unemployment benefit is due. Example: entitlement starts on 5 May - from 5 May until 18 May no unemployment benefit is paid because of a sanction - the first day for which unemployment benefit is due is 19 May. End date is the last day for which benefits were paid within the reimbursement period. (The reimbursement period must not exceed 3 or 5 months).

Element.Name: lastPaymentDate
Element.Label: Last payment date
Element.Explanatory: State the date of the last payment of unemployment benefits for which the reimbursement is requested. This date is the reference date for the determination of the deadline for submitting the reimbursement request (Article 70(1) of Regulation (EC) No 987/2009).

Element.Name: RequestedAmountForReimbursement
Element.Label: Requested amount for reimbursement
Element.Explanatory: Requested amount for reimbursement. State the gross amount according to point V.2. of Decision U4 - i.e. the amount is comprised of the total cost of unemployment benefits.

Element.Name: entitlementSicknessBenefitsInKind
Element.Label: Entitlement to sickness benefits in kind
Element.Explanatory: Indicate the person's entitlement to sickness benefits in kind.

Element.Name: fitForWorkDeclarationInsuredPerson
Element.Label: Fit for work declaration of the insured person
Element.Explanatory: Verify that the insured person is/is not fit for work. If the insured person is not fit for work, there should be a medical report attached.

Element.Name: constantAttendanceDeclarationInsuredPerson
Element.Label: Constant attendance declaration of the insured person
Element.Explanatory: Verify whether the insured person needs/does not need constant attendance, being unable to undertake without assistance normal everyday needs such as feeding and clothing him/herself. If the insured person does need the constant attendance, a medical report should be attached.

Element.Name: functionalCapacityDeclarationInsuredPerson
Element.Label: Functional capacity declaration of the insured person
Element.Explanatory: Indicate that the insured person’s functional capacity has / has not been reduced to such a degree by illness/injury that he/she is no longer able to perform ordinary everyday activities or that the illness/injury has / has not imposed an additional long-term financial strain (medical report should be attached).

Element.Name: sufficientMeansSubsistenceDeclarationInsuredPersonIndicator
Element.Label: Sufficient means of subsistence declaration of the insured person
Element.Explanatory: State that the insured person does/ does not have the means to support himself and his family (personal statement by the insured person should be attached).

Element.Name: assistanceBenefit
Element.Label: Assistance benefit
Element.Explanatory: Verify whether the person has applied for or receives benefits in respect of assistance by another person in order to enable him/her to perform the ordinary activities of everyday life.

Element.Name: benefitsWithAdditionalBenefitsIndicator
Element.Label: Benefits with additional benefits
Element.Explanatory: Verify whether the insured person is receiving an additional benefit in respect of assistance by another person in order to enable him/her to perform the ordinary activities of everyday life and that this benefit may be reduced, if a similar benefit is granted by another institution.

Element.Name: PropertyInRespectPersonOwnerOrHolder

Element.Name: reasonForPartialNonAcceptance
Element.Label: Reason for partial non-acceptance
Element.Explanatory: 01 - "Partial acceptance due to ceiling under national law": select if the individual claim is only partially accepted because the ceiling applied by the Member State of last activity under Article 65(6) of Regulation (EC) No 883/2004 is lower than the requested amount for reimbursement. 02 - "Period not justified": select if the period of 5 months for reimbursement is not justified (the condition under Article 65(7) of Regulation (EC) No. 883/2004 is not met). 03 - "Reimbursement claim incomplete": select if the reimbursement claim for the individual claim is incomplete - specify in the field "Information on missing data". 99 - "Other reason or additional information": select if there is another reason for further clarification or specific information to be communicated. Where the individual claim was partially accepted by the Debtor in the previous U023 - "Reimbursement Contestation" and is marked "Under dispute" by the Creditor in U029 - "Amended reimbursement request reacting to contestation" and where the Debtor does not accept the reasoning provided by the Creditor, it should state further arguments under "Other reason or additional information".

Element.Name: reasonForNonAcceptance

Element.Explanatory: 01 - "Submitted after time limit": tick the box if the individual claim (within the general reimbursement request) was submitted after time limit (Article 70 (1) of Regulation (EC) No 978/2009). 02 - "No period recognised": tick the box if condition under point I.3. of Decision U4 is not fulfilled, i.e. there are no employment/self-employment periods recognised for the purposes of unemployment benefits in the Debtor State. 99 - "Other reason or additional information": If box is ticked, please specify the reason for non-acceptance of the individual claim in question. Where the individual claim was not-accepted by the Debtor in the previous U023 - "Reimbursement Contestation" and is marked "Under dispute" by the Creditor in U029 - "Amended reimbursement request reacting to contestation" and where the Debtor does not accept the reasoning provided by the Creditor, it should state further arguments under "Other reason".

Element.Name: benefits
Element.Label: Benefits
Element.Explanatory: Verify whether the person concerned has applied for or is receiving (one of) the following cash benefits, whether short- or long termed and from which social security institution the benefit is paid. For further distinction continued wage or salary payments in case of illness refer to sick pay by the employer and pre-retirement benefits refer to cash benefits provided from a specified age to workers, who have reduced, ceased or suspended their remunerative activities until the age at which they qualify for an old-age pension or an early retirement pension.

Element.Name: Persons
Element.Label: Persons
Element.Explanatory: SEDs can include details of more than one person (e.g. insured person and widow in case of survivor benefits or the heir of a deceased benefit recipient who is liable to refund the overpayment). It is important to define clearly who is who. It allows the receiving institution to identify, assign and proceed the sent data correctly. To help categorise the persons, the ‘Persons’ section consists in two sections ‘Debtor’ and ‘Other Persons’. The mandatory section ‘Debtor’ has a choice field where the Debtor category is selected between ‘Insured Person’, ‘Beneficiary’ and ‘Third Party’. Based on the selection of the ‘Debtor’ category, one, two or three corresponding non-repetitive subsections become visible. In each section, an adapted list of statuses is available (when relevant for ‘Beneficiary’ and ‘Third Party’). The non-mandatory repetitive section labelled ‘Other Persons’ is provided following the ‘Debtor’ section to contain other persons of interest in the case. Exceptional case: If the debtor is a liable heir of a deceased benefit recipient but the personal data of the heir is unknown you are not able to fill in the name and other data of the debtor. In this exceptional case please use in the Debtor category ‘Insured Person’ or ‘Beneficiary’ (with Status ‘Deceased beneficiary’) and fill in the data of the deceased benefit recipient instead.

Element.Name: Persons
Element.Label: Persons
Element.Explanatory: SEDs can include details of more than one person (e.g. insured person and widow in case of survivor benefits or the heir of a deceased benefit recipient who is liable to refund the overpayment). It is important to define clearly who is who. It allows the receiving institution to identify, assign and proceed the sent data correctly. To help categorise the persons, the ‘Persons’ section consists in two sections ‘Debtor’ and ‘Other Persons’. The mandatory section ‘Debtor’ has a choice field where the Debtor category is selected between ‘Insured Person’, ‘Beneficiary’ and ‘Third Party’. Based on the selection of the ‘Debtor’ category, one, two or three corresponding non-repetitive subsections become visible. In each section, an adapted list of statuses is available (when relevant for ‘Beneficiary’ and ‘Third Party’). The non-mandatory repetitive section labelled ‘Other Persons’ is provided following the ‘Debtor’ section to contain other persons of interest in the case.

Element.Name: Persons
Element.Label: Persons
Element.Explanatory: SEDs can include details of more than one person (e.g. insured person and widow in case of survivor benefits or the heir of a deceased benefit recipient who is liable to refund the overpayment). It is important to define clearly who is who. It allows the receiving institution to identify, assign and proceed the sent data correctly. To help categorise the persons, the ‘Persons’ section consists in two sections ‘Debtor’ and ‘Other Persons’. The mandatory section ‘Debtor’ has a choice field where the Debtor category is selected between ‘Insured Person’, ‘Beneficiary’ and ‘Third Party’. Based on the selection of the ‘Debtor’ category, one, two or three corresponding non-repetitive subsections become visible. In each section, an adapted list of statuses is available (when relevant for ‘Beneficiary’ and ‘Third Party’). The non-mandatory repetitive section labelled ‘Other Persons’ is provided following the ‘Debtor’ section to contain other persons of interest in the case.

Element.Name: statusPerson
Element.Label: Status of the person
Element.Explanatory: Please state what the role of the person concerned is. SEDs can include details of more than one person (e.g. insured person and widow in case of survivor benefits or the heir of a deceased benefit recipient who is liable to refund the overpayment). It is important to define clearly who is who. This will help the receiving institution to identify, assign and proceed the sent data correctly. "Insured person" and "employee" should not be interpreted in the same way. *) "Employee" is relevant for recovery of contributions, *) "Insured person" is relevant for offsetting/recovery of overpaid benefits (e.g. survivor's benefits or payments after the death of a benefit recipient). Element.Name: Persons
Element.Label: Persons
Element.Explanatory: SEDs can include details of more than one person (e.g. insured person and widow in case of survivor benefits or the heir of a deceased benefit recipient who is liable to refund the overpayment). It is important to define clearly who is who. It allows the receiving institution to identify, assign and proceed the sent data correctly. To help categorise the persons, the ‘Persons’ section consists in two sections ‘Debtor’ and ‘Other Persons’. The mandatory section ‘Debtor’ has a choice field where the Debtor category is selected between ‘Insured Person’, ‘Beneficiary’ and ‘Third Party’. Based on the selection of the ‘Debtor’ category, one, two or three corresponding non-repetitive subsections become visible. In each section, an adapted list of statuses is available (when relevant for ‘Beneficiary’ and ‘Third Party’). The non-mandatory repetitive section labelled ‘Other Persons’ is provided following the ‘Debtor’ section to contain other persons of interest in the case. Exceptional case: If the debtor is a liable heir of a deceased benefit recipient but the personal data of the heir is unknown you are not able to fill in the name and other data of the debtor. In this exceptional case please use in the Debtor category ‘Insured Person’ or ‘Beneficiary’ (with Status ‘Deceased beneficiary’) and fill in the data of the deceased benefit recipient instead.

Element.Name: sameHouseholdSpouseOrPartnerIndicator

Element.Name: insuredInPolandAMemberOpenPensionFundIndicator
Element.Label: The insured person is in Poland a Member of the Open Pension Fund (Otwarty Fundusz Emerytalny)
Element.Explanatory: Please indicate whether an insured person in Poland is a member of the open pension fund.

Element.Name: insuredRequestsFundsFromOpenPensionFundEarlyIndicator
Element.Label: The insured person requests for transfer of the funds from the Open Pension Fund (Otwarty Fundusz Emerytalny) account via ZUS on revenue side of the State Budget to obtain early retirement pension
Element.Explanatory: Please check if the insured person requests for a transfer of funds from the account in an open pension fund, via the Social Insurance Institution, to the revenue of the state budget in order to obtain early retirement.

Element.Name: InitialCapitalConcernsPersonsBornAfter31121948
Element.Label: Initial capital (concerns persons born after 31.12.1948)
Element.Explanatory: The initial capital means the amount determined on the basis of a hypothetical pension calculated on the basis of insurance periods completed before the 1999. The initial capital is taken into account in the calculation of pensions in the new pension system for those persons born after 1948., which paid social security contributions before 1999 in Poland or who have worked and been insured in Poland before that date.

Element.Name: presentlyInsuredRequestsCalculatingInitialCapitalIndicator
Element.Label: Presently the insured person requests for calculating of initial capital
Element.Explanatory: Verify if the insured person requests for the establishing of initial capital.

Element.Name: insuredAppliesAcceptedPensionAssessmentBasis
Element.Label: The insured person applies for the following to be accepted as pension assessment basis
Element.Explanatory: The insured person requests for one of the following options as the basis of benefit.

Element.Name: FillInIfTheInsuredPersonApplies
Element.Label: Please fill in the following if "The insured person applies for the following to be accepted as pension assessment basis" = "Average basis of contribution assessment for social insurance or old-age and disability insurance according to Polish regulations, in the period of 10 subsequent calendar years, selected from the past 20 calendar years, immediately preceding the year in which the claim was submitted (from-to)" :

Element.Name: checkIfAmountOldAgePensionBetterThanOlderRulesIndicator
Element.Label: Claim for the comparison if a calculation of amount of old-age pension according to new rules (concerns persons born before 1.01.1949) is more favourable than a calculation according to the old rules
Element.Explanatory: A person entitled to a pension under the old system can check whether the calculation of pensions under the new system would be more favourable, if the claimant is still insured after reaching retirement age.

Element.Name: Person
Element.Label: Person
Element.Explanatory: The jobseeker (former cross-border worker) concerned who received unemployment benefits from the Member State of residence.

Element.Name: InstitutionWhichCertifiedInsuranceRecord
Element.Label: Institution which certified insurance record
Element.Explanatory: Details of the institution in the Member State of last activity which certified the periods of insurance/employment which were considered by the Member State of residence for the entitlement to unemployment benefit for which the reimbursement is claimed.

Element.Name: WorkingPeriodsConsidered
Element.Label: Working periods considered
Element.Explanatory: Periods of employment and self-employment completed in the Member State of last activity during the preceding 24 months. Depending on the length of these periods a 3 or 5 month reimbursement claim is justified under Article 65(7) of Regulation (EC) No 883/2004.

Element.Name: ReimbursementPeriod
Element.Label: Reimbursement period
Element.Explanatory: Period for which the reimbursement is requested. Start date is the first day for which unemployment benefit is due. Example: entitlement starts on 5 May - from 5 May until 18 May no unemployment benefit is paid because of a sanction - the first day for which unemployment benefit is due is 19 May. End date is the last day for which benefits were paid within the reimbursement period. (The reimbursement period must not exceed 3 or 5 months).

Element.Name: lastPaymentDate
Element.Label: Last payment date
Element.Explanatory: State the date of the last payment of unemployment benefits for which the reimbursement is requested. This date is the reference date for the determination of the deadline for submitting the reimbursement request (Article 70(1) of Regulation (EC) No 987/2009).

Element.Name: RequestedAmountForReimbursement
Element.Label: Requested amount for reimbursement
Element.Explanatory: Requested amount for reimbursement. State the gross amount according to point V.2. of Decision U4 - i.e. the amount is comprised of the total cost of unemployment benefits.

Element.Name: entitlementSicknessBenefitsInKind
Element.Label: Entitlement to sickness benefits in kind
Element.Explanatory: Indicate the person's entitlement to sickness benefits in kind.

Element.Name: assistanceBenefit
Element.Label: Assistance benefit
Element.Explanatory: Verify whether the person has applied for or receives benefits in respect of assistance by another person in order to enable him/her to perform the ordinary activities of everyday life.

Element.Name: globalIOReferenceLiaisonBody
Element.Label: Global IO reference Liaison Body
Element.Explanatory: A unique reference number of the IO specified in the DA071, which should be copied without any change.

Element.Name: globalACPIOReferenceLiaisonBody
Element.Label: Global ACP_IO reference Liaison Body
Element.Explanatory: A unique reference number of the acceptance of the IO specified in the global part of DA073A which allows to link individual decisions IO (DA074) with the acceptance IO (DA073A) and should be copied without a change.

Element.Name: globalDecisionIOReferenceDebtorLiaisonBody
Element.Label: Global decision IO reference Debtor Liaison Body
Element.Explanatory: A reference number of the decision on the IO which allows to identify the decision in any future communication (links the SEDs). It is a unique number for given decision and is repeated subsequently in the following SEDs at the global and at the individual level of SED.

Element.Name: totalNumberIndividualDecisionIO
Element.Label: Total number of individual decision IO's
Element.Explanatory: A summarize number of individual decisions on the IO which should be equal to the number of repeated individual parts of DA074.

Element.Name: TotalAmountIndividualOverpayments
Element.Label: Total amount of individual overpayments
Element.Explanatory: A summarize amount of the overpayments specified in each individual part of DA074.

Element.Name: dateSubmission
Element.Label: Date of submission
Element.Explanatory: Date when the current SED is submitted.

Element.Name: doesChildLiveTogetherWithBothParentsIndicator
Element.Label: Does the child live together with both parents?

Element.Name: FillInFollowingIfDoesChildLiveTogether
Element.Label: Please fill in the following if "Does the child live together with both parents?" = "No"

Element.Label: A claim for the calculating of initial capital was submitted previously by the insured person
Element.Explanatory: Please check if the insured person was previously asked for the calculating of initial capital. If yes, please provide the name of the branch of ZUS.

Element.Name: giveNameZUSBranchOfficeCompetent
Element.Label: If yes, please give name of ZUS Branch Office competent for calculating of initial capital and case reference number in this ZUS for the case of initial capital

Element.Name: GainfulEmployment
Element.Label: Gainful employment
Element.Explanatory: Indicate whether the person pursues gainful employment. Note: All sources of income should be considered.

Element.Name: PleaseFillInFollowingIfPensionAPensionGranted
Element.Label: Please fill in the following if "Pension" = "A pension is granted" :

Element.Name: dateClaim
Element.Label: Date of claim
Element.Explanatory: State the date when the insured person submitted the original pension claim.

Element.Name: recipientDecision
Element.Label: Recipient of the decision
Element.Explanatory: Please specify whether the pension decision is to be sent to the person concerned, to a representative of the person concerned, or to the both of them.

Element.Name: deductionsGrounds
Element.Label: Deductions grounds
Element.Explanatory: Indicate here if there might also be an offsetting procedure related to this case. This is not an official request to offset benefits but this way the receiving institution will know to expect the offsetting procedure. The official request for offsetting will be done by the use of Recovery SEDs.

Element.Name: PleaseFillInFollowingIfAttachmentsOther
Element.Label: Please fill in the following if "Attachments" = "Other" :

Element.Name: startDateLivingTogether
Element.Label: Start date of living together
Element.Explanatory: Indicate the date from which the insured person lived in the same household as the spouse or partner.

Element.Name: noWorkAccidentAndNoOccupationalDiseaseInvalidityIndicator
Element.Label: Invalidity caused by other accident than work accident or by other reason than occupational disease
Element.Explanatory: Indicate whether the incapacity to work is the result of an accident other than an accident at work or an occupational disease.

Element.Name: rehabilitationCourses
Element.Label: Rehabilitation courses
Element.Explanatory: Indicate whether the insured person followed occupational rehabilitation courses since stopping work, specify, if medical or occupational.

Element.Name: constantAttendanceDeclarationInsuredPerson
Element.Label: Constant attendance declaration of the insured person
Element.Explanatory: Verify whether the insured person needs/does not need constant attendance, being unable to undertake without assistance normal everyday needs such as feeding and clothing him/herself. If the insured person needs constant attendance, medical evidence should be submitted, if available.

Element.Name: IndividualDecisionIO
Element.Label: Individual decision IO
Element.Explanatory: Provide the relevant details of the individual decision on the identified overpayment.

Element.Name: uncertainDatesIndicator
Element.Label: Uncertain dates
Element.Explanatory: If the insured person or claimant (survivor's pensions) only can provide assumed or vague periods of employment / self-employment without a concrete date e.g. worked in Member State(xx) in 1975, then fill in the start date with fictitious date 01/01/1975, end date with fictitious date 31/12/1975, choose "Uncertain dates" with "Yes" and attach the document where the insured person or claimant has stated the alleged period of employment / self-employment. If the insured person or claimant provides concrete dates for a period of employment / self- employment e.g. worked in MSxx from 15/01/2001 until 29/01/2002 then data field "Fixed period" should be chosen, start date filled in with 15/01/2001, end date with 29/01/2002 and "Uncertain dates" with "No". Work certificates etc. should be attached. The same procedure is valid for all other periods contained in P4000.

Element.Explanatory: Indicate whether the incapacity to work is caused by another accident than an accident at work or by other reason than an occupational disease.

Element.Name: insuranceAgainstWorkIncapacityIndicator

Element.Explanatory: Indicate whether the person was insured against work incapacity at the moment of commencement of incapacity for work, either as a worker or other than a worker.

Element.Name: RehabilitationCourses
Element.Label: Rehabilitation courses
Element.Explanatory: Indicate whether the insured person followed occupational rehabilitation courses since stopping work, specify, if medical or occupational.

Element.Name: pleaseProvideMoreDetailsIf99OtherSelected
Element.Label: Please provide more details if "99-Other" is selected

Element.Name: FamilyStatus
Element.Label: Family status
Element.Explanatory: State the family status of the person and the date from whereon the status is effective. If the person has had previous family statuses state also those with their corresponding dates. All the family statuses that the person has had during his/her life should be given here.

Element.Name: GainfulEmployment
Element.Label: Gainful employment
Element.Explanatory: Indicate whether the person pursues gainful employment. Note: All sources of income should be considered.

Element.Name: fitForWork
Element.Label: Fit for work
Element.Explanatory: Indicate if the spouse/partner is / is not fit for work.

Element.Name: ThePensionReceivedBasedOn
Element.Label: The pension received is based on

Element.Name: pensionNonWorkingPerson
Element.Label: Pension as non-working person
Element.Explanatory: Indicate whether the spouse/partner has applied for or is receiving a pension as a non-working person.

Element.Name: OtherBenefitsReceivedBySpouse
Element.Label: Other benefits received by the spouse
Element.Explanatory: Verify whether the spouse/partner receives other benefits such as unemployment, sickness, invalidity, other.

Element.Name: OtherResourcesSourcesIncome
Element.Label: Other resources - sources of income
Element.Explanatory: State the income (resource/type of income) received by the person. All sources of income should be considered.

Element.Name: globalIOReferenceLiaisonBody
Element.Label: Global IO Reference Liaison Body
Element.Explanatory: A unique reference number of the IO specified in the global part of DA071, which allows to link the individual reply to contestation of the IO (DA073R) with the global IO (DA071) and should be copied without a change.

Element.Name: globalCOCIOReferenceLiaisonBody
Element.Label: Global COC_IO reference Liaison Body
Element.Explanatory: A unique reference number of the contestation of the IO copied from the global part of DA073C which allows to link individual reply to contestation IO (DA073R) with the global part of DA073C and should be copied without a change.

Element.Name: globalRPYCOCIOReferenceLiaisonBody
Element.Label: Global RPY_COC_IO reference Liaison Body
Element.Explanatory: A unique reference number of the reply to contestation of the IO specified in the global part of DA073R which allows to link individual replies with the global part of DA073R and should be copied without a change.

Element.Name: individualIONumberLiaisonBody
Element.Label: Individual IO number Liaison Body
Element.Explanatory: A unique reference number of the individual IO specified in the individual part of DA071 which allows to link the individual reply to contestation IO (DA073R) with individual IO (DA071) and should be copied without a change.

Property.Property: Define a unique key for a field in repetitive section=

Element.Name: individualCOCIONumberLiaisonBody
Element.Label: Individual COC_IO number Liaison Body
Element.Explanatory: A unique reference number of the individual contestation IO specified in the individual part of DA073C which allows to link the individual reply to contestation IO (DA073R) with the individual contestation IO (DA073C) and should be copied without a change

Property.Property: Define a unique key for a field in repetitive section=

Element.Name: individualRPYCOCIONumberLiaisonBody
Element.Label: Individual RPY_COC_IO number Liaison Body
Element.Explanatory: A unique reference number of the individual reply to contestation IO which allows to identify the reply in the next step of the exchange and in any future communication (links the SEDs). It is a unique number for given individual reply.

Element.Name: startPensionPaymentDesiredByInsuredPerson
Element.Label: Start of pension payment desired by the insured person

Element.Name: LatePaymentAmount
Element.Label: Late Payment Amount
Element.Explanatory: The amount of the claim which has been paid after the time limits set in the regulation and which has not been covered by down payment and for which a claim for interest is issued (art. 16 of decision S9). It is to be provided in the currency of the Creditor member state.

Element.Name: dateFromWhichInsuredPersonFitForWork
Element.Label: Date from which the insured person is fit for work

Element.Name: AdditionalInformationInsuredPerson
Element.Label: Additional information on the insured person

Element.Name: UnableProvideRequestedInformationInThisSection
Element.Label: Unable to provide the requested information in this section
Element.Explanatory: P3000XX contains the country specific information to enable the competent institution in the receiving country to decide upon the pension claim. Only if the contact institution is not able to provide any of the information requested in this section, then tick the box "No" and state the reason why.
